propositions: Repository-wide documentation and comments fail to conform to established prose standards including prohibited punctuation, formal voice, filler removal, and paragraph structure.

Documentation ownership, lifecycle, audience classification, and canonical sourcing lack explicit policy, creating ambiguity across durable records, internal documents, external guidance, and shipped help.
Generated artifacts including configuration reference, CLI reference, MCP reference, and derived content lack documented ownership, source tracking, regeneration contracts, and drift detection.
Developer comments and embedded prose require targeted validation and remediation through expanded hygiene checks while preserving contextual necessity and technical accuracy.
Documentation navigation, internal indexing, and link validation need consolidation and coverage expansion to detect broken references outside the docs directory and maintain current-state accuracy.
